question: For `exec host=node`, should the Gateway drop only an inherited local workspace default while preserving explicit node workdirs, with the node resolving and reporting invalid remote paths?
rationale: The documented contract requires node-side workdir support, but the report shows that treating a Gateway-local inherited path as a node cwd is unsafe; the compatibility boundary needs owner intent before a repair is selected.

options.title: Preserve remote workdirs, drop inherited defaults
options.body: Keep explicit node paths and `node://` locators, but omit the Gateway-derived default before forwarding and return a node-local cwd diagnostic when an explicit remote path is invalid.

options.title: Require node locators only
options.body: Reject non-`node://` workdirs for node exec, trading clearer ownership for a breaking restriction on existing absolute node paths.

recommendation.title: Preserve remote workdirs, drop inherited defaults
recommendation.body: Keep explicit node paths and `node://` locators, but omit the Gateway-derived default before forwarding and return a node-local cwd diagnostic when an explicit remote path is invalid.
